Bears vs Lions Betting History

The Chicago Bears and Detroit Lions have met 119 times since the 1966 season. The Lions lead the series 60-58-1. Against the closing spread the Bears are 49-67-3 (Lions 67-49-3), and the over is 43-49-1 in meetings with a closing total. Last meeting: Jan 4, 2026, Lions 19-16.
